name: The Pacific Northwest

signs.note: NEW, playtest 3, T12.6 (the maintainer, round 3: "Salmon: STILL RAINING"): the words on the neon roof sign's board, over an invented leaping salmon, in the spot Portland's famous stag sign holds. A text surface, not a board: the game paints it on the model's `pdx_roof_sign_words` panel (docs/content-packs.md, Text surfaces), and cutting it in the game leaves the board blank. Vetoable like any sign.

meta.notes: Region 2, crude first (playtest 1c, 2026-09-30, roadmap change [decided]: "Pnw and sf first then others"). Grey-green palette with the riders' own saturated colours on top; the palette keys follow the render look's material kinds (sky, water, road, shoulder, land, rail, deck) plus fog, foliage, trunk and accent for the render lane's palette hook. The look calls for drizzle; weather stays reserved, so the palette carries it (W-O, 2026-10-01, render only): `rain` turns on the drizzle, `sunlight` and `skylight` set the overcast light, and `foliage`, `foliageDark` and `trunk` paint the conifers. Traffic mixes this pack's placeholder vehicles (each reuses an existing shape) with base's pickup and rental. Every name and line is a placeholder the maintainer may veto. Playtest 3 (T10.5): a rainy `dusk` for downtown Portland's neon hour (the rain palette key is on in every time of day), and two traffic areas, `pdx-blocks` and `pdx-deck`, that give Bridge City city cars, cyclists and the streetcar instead of the forest's mix (the four `site` signs on its roads are placed by its road files).
